title: רבנאי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Ravnai in Abaye's name: Berakhot 38b. Ravnai reports Shmuel in Yoma 21a and Hullin 76b. ‘But Ravnai said’: Bava Metzia 2a. Maharshal writes that it should read Ravina. That matter at 27 also has Ravnai, and he emends nothing. See Ha-Mokher Perot: another version, R' Banai.
